purpose: Determine whether public primary sources provide a complete clean-room prescription for the historical SEOBNRv4 35-mode pre-NQC radiation-reaction flux. This is a source-completeness gate, not a numerical-proximity gate.

bohe.citation: Bohé et al., Phys. Rev. D 95, 044028 (2017), arXiv:1611.03703v3, Sec. II.B, Eqs. (4)-(9); source paper.tex lines 303-354

taracchini_2012.citation: Taracchini et al., Phys. Rev. D 86, 024011 (2012), arXiv:1202.0790v2, Sec. II.B and Appendix A

taracchini_2014.citation: Taracchini et al., Phys. Rev. D 89, 061502 (2014), arXiv:1311.2544v1, factorized waveform discussion following Eq. (2); source paper.tex lines 247-270

pan.citation: Pan et al., Phys. Rev. D 83, 064003 (2011), arXiv:1006.0431v2, Secs. III-V and Appendices B-C

din.citation: Damour, Iyer, and Nagar, Phys. Rev. D 79, 064004 (2009), arXiv:0811.2069v2, Secs. II-IV and appendices

context_only_sources.citation: Barausse and Buonanno, Phys. Rev. D 81, 084024 (2010), arXiv:0912.3517
context_only_sources.reason: Referenced for comparable-mass spin terms; it does not identify the final SEOBNRv4 mode-by-mode assembly.

context_only_sources.citation: Buonanno, Faye, and Hinderer, Phys. Rev. D 87, 044009 (2013), arXiv:1209.6349v2
context_only_sources.reason: Publishes generic-mass-ratio spin terms; it does not prescribe their complete historical SEOBNRv4 merge with test-particle terms.

mandatory_requirements.description: The historical model fixes the active multipole range, flux normalization, and whether NQC corrections enter radiation reaction.
The public prescription fixes the common factorized mode architecture and even/odd-parity effective-source rule.
The v4 paper identifies the v4-specific (2,2) amplitude and phase replacements relative to the cited predecessor.
The public sources identify the historical residual-amplitude representation used for low-ell odd-m modes.
The public sources uniquely select whether the published higher-spin (4,3) terms enter the Taylor residual factor or the rho_43 factor before the fourth power.
The public sources provide one unambiguous final 35-mode selector after combining comparable-mass and test-particle spin terms, including per-mode replacement, coexistence, and truncation rules.

pass_rule: Every mandatory requirement must be satisfied by the pinned public primary sources. A GPL implementation, binary-oracle match, conditional single-mode paper check, or numerical agreement cannot fill a missing prescription field.
clean_room_exclusions: Do not inspect or transcribe LALSimulation source or historical mode coefficients.
Do not query or fit to a LALSimulation binary oracle.
Do not infer a historical selector by choosing whichever algebraic placement or published alternative best matches an implementation or NR data.
